in_marathi.name: Ambuvahini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे She who carries the ambu (water pot)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambuvahini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ambuvahini is the divine goddess who carries the Amrita Kalasha (divine pot of nectar) during Hindu rituals and festivals. She is often depicted carrying a water pot and is believed to bestow blessings of prosperity and good fortune.
